fact_sheet: One-time price: $29.99, now $19.99 for a limited time (the same number in USD, CAD, EUR, GBP, AUD)
A license covers up to 3 Macs
Every update through version 1, ready for each new macOS when it ships
Try before you buy: scanning is always free, clean up to 2 GB before buying, no card needed

shipped_features.feature: Scan the Mac and show what fills it, by category
Smart clean: one screen, pre-ticked safe categories, one Clean up button
Review sheet lists every item before anything is removed
Personal files go to the Trash; caches and build files tools rebuild are deleted
Developer caches and build files: Xcode DerivedData, node_modules, package caches, Docker
Complete app uninstalls, including leftover files from deleted apps
Audio software section: DAWs, plug-ins by maker, sounds and samples, drivers; uninstall plug-ins
Photo and video category: Adobe media cache (also moved locations, Peak Files), Premiere Pro and After Effects caches, Final Cut Pro render files; optimized/proxy media per library
Explore storage with a storage map
System Data explained and partly cleaned (caches, logs inside it)
Worth a look: apps not opened in 6 months and files from deleted apps, never pre-ticked
Empty Trash from CacheDrop, listing everything first; menu bar shows the Trash
Optional weekly reminder when at least 1 GB is ready to clean (off by default)
History of what each cleanup freed
Checks for updates weekly; installs only when you choose
Results show the space measurably got back

never_claim: Speeding up the Mac by a stated percentage
Finding duplicate files or calling a plug-in unused
